outfit.top: Refined deep teal wrap blouse with a modest V neckline, clean overlap construction, natural fitted structure, and long sleeves ending neatly at the wrists.
outfit.bottom: High-waisted warm-gray pleated skirt with moderate volume, stable waist placement, and a hem that allows the seated leg angle and footwear to remain readable.
outfit.footwear: Simple warm-gray low-profile closed-toe flats with a shallow heel, secure fit, and minimal decoration; practical for a conservatory and unlikely to distort the feet or ankles.
outfit.accessories: Small understated silver earrings only. No necklace, hair ornaments, handbag, visible branding, or distracting jewelry.
outfit.materials_and_finish: Matte-to-soft-satin blouse fabric, lightly textured skirt fabric, clean seams, believable folds, and no excessive lace, embroidery, transparency, or reflective trim.
outfit.color_harmony: Deep teal, warm gray, and restrained silver coordinated with dark blue-black hair and blue eyes; maintain clear separation between clothing and the face.

clothing_decisions.fit_and_construction: Keep the wrap blouse securely overlapped without gaping, the waist seam aligned naturally, pleats falling from the high waist without intersecting the hands, and all garments free of floating edges or fused anatomy.
clothing_decisions.hairstyle_interaction: Keep the soft side-parted dark blue-black waves above or beside the blouse neckline, with the forehead, hairline, earrings, and facial silhouette unobstructed.
clothing_decisions.seasonal_and_occasion_read: Polished spring or early-autumn conservatory attire: refined and adult, but not formal, costume-like, childish, or overly trend-specific.

locked_constraints: Use trigger token inr20 and preserve the approved age-20 identity reference.
Preserve the deep teal wrap blouse and high-waisted warm-gray pleated skirt for this image.
Keep the blouse neckline modest and the face, neck, and major facial structure unobstructed.
Keep clothing fitted but natural, with plausible wrap construction, waist placement, pleats, seams, folds, and garment-to-body intersections.
Use only small understated silver earrings; no logos, text, distracting accessories, or identity-confounding adornment.

No extra limbs, broken joints, impossible garment attachments, severe deformation, text, watermark, duplicate subject, or distracting prop.

intentional_variations.clothing: Add controlled outfit diversity through a sophisticated deep-teal wrap blouse, warm-gray pleated skirt, and restrained silver accents rather than repeating a standard portrait outfit.
intentional_variations.silhouette: Use a modest fitted upper body with a structured high waist and softly pleated lower silhouette; keep volume moderate so the torso, arms, knees, and feet remain legible.
intentional_variations.footwear: Introduce practical low-profile flats as a stable footwear variation while preserving grounded seated anatomy.
intentional_variations.palette: Use deep teal and warm gray as a calm, coordinated palette that contrasts gently with the blue-black hair without competing with the face.
intentional_variations.season_and_occasion: Suggest refined spring or early-autumn daytime attire suitable for a quiet conservatory visit.
intentional_variations.accessory_control: Limit accessories to small silver earrings to provide subtle variation without creating new identity signals.
intentional_variations.pose_support: Ensure the blouse sleeves permit natural forearm placement, the skirt allows one hand to lightly hold the skirt edge, and the pleats remain readable without covering the fingers.
intentional_variations.scene_support: Coordinate matte fabrics and restrained colors with pale window frames, green foliage, and the muted stone bench so the clothing remains distinct but subordinate to identity.
intentional_variations.camera_support: Maintain enough head-to-feet framing and soft, even lighting to inspect neckline, garment intersections, hands, knees, ankles, and footwear without wide-angle exaggeration.

notes.production_guidance: Generate one integrated image using the approved identity reference and the specified clothing variation. Treat clothing as supportive structure, not the primary subject. Favor clean construction, stable folds, unobstructed hands and face, and believable seated balance.
adjustable_choices: Minor blouse fabric texture, pleat density, and flat-shoe sole thickness may vary if the teal-and-warm-gray palette, silhouette, anatomy readability, and modest styling remain intact.
Small natural variations in sleeve fold direction and skirt drape are acceptable when caused by the seated pose.
unresolved_conflicts: The closed-toe flats improve generation stability but limit direct toe visibility; prioritize clear foot and ankle shape, natural shoe contact, and absence of malformed or duplicated digits where toes are visible.
The skirt edge may be lightly held by one hand, but the fabric must not cover the fingers or compromise the exact-digit anatomy check.
notes.quality_gate: PASS only if the outfit reads as deep teal wrap blouse, warm-gray high-waisted pleated skirt, understated silver earrings, and simple warm-gray flats; all garments fit plausibly, remain free of logos and artifacts, support the seated pose, and do not obscure identity or anatomy.
notes.repair_policy: Any clothing repair requires a complete recheck of identity, apparent age, hair and eye color, facial readability, garment construction, hands, feet, joints, balance, clothing intersections, accessories, skin texture, and unwanted artifacts.
rejection_triggers: Outfit substitution that removes the teal blouse or warm-gray pleated skirt
Childlike, sexualized, costume-like, or excessively ornate styling

Malformed garment-body intersections, floating fabric, fused limbs, or clothing that hides anatomy-critical areas

Logos, text, watermark, duplicate subject, excessive transparency, or distracting accessories
Identity drift, age drift, wrong hair or eye color, malformed hands or feet, or any extra limb or impossible joint
